scenes.title: Hook
scenes.line: This is Knox Defense Force. Thirty-one cases, nineteen commands, zero blind takedowns. Every action has a reason, a record, and a receipt.

scenes.title: What it does
scenes.line: TypeSafe watches chat, voice, and reports. It screens messages against your server's own rulebook, gates reports with an A.I. validity check, and puts the real calls in your moderators' hands.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.line: Five steps. Detect the event. Judge it against your written rules, with a heuristic floor as backup. Open a vote when it's serious. Act. Then log everything, with receipts.

scenes.title: Use cases: chat
scenes.line: Nitro scam in general chat? Flagged and logged. Someone posting doxxing? Even when the judge is offline, the heuristic floor still routes it to a human with a jump link. Nothing severe disappears.

scenes.title: Use cases: voice and nukes
scenes.line: Voice moderation works the same way: spam caller disconnected, case filed in the mod log. And if a rogue admin starts deleting channels, anti-nuke reverses the damage and alerts the owner instantly.

scenes.title: Votes
scenes.line: Serious cases go to a community vote. This report scored a point nine four validity. Mods voted three to one, and the one hour mute upholds. Any moderator can veto with one command.

scenes.title: Alerts, your way
scenes.line: Alerts stay out of your D M s by default. Routine cases post to a log channel, exactly like the one you just saw in our live server. Owners only get D M s for critical events, and slash notify flips it in one command.

scenes.title: Setup
scenes.line: Setup is four steps: clone, install, token, run. Dry-run mode watches before it ever enforces, and no dashboard is needed. slash recent, slash me, and slash panel all work inside Discord.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.line: Reads your rules. Shows the receipts. TypeSafe.
